### Thank you for being part of the GXO Innovation Tour 2026 in Almere.


It was a pleasure to welcome you for a day of inspiring conversations, innovation, and collaboration. Together, we explored how leading organizations are leveraging AI, automation, robotics, and data to shape the future of logistics.


We hope the experience sparked new ideas and valuable connections that will continue beyond the event.


## Your feedback


Your feedback helps us improve future GXO Innovation Tours and continue delivering valuable experiences. Please take a few minutes to share your thoughts and key takeaways.
